verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions React Email, MJML, or any first-party email-as-code framework. The Templates CRUD API and the drag-and-drop editor are adjacent: they would only let a developer build their own code-to-template sync workflow, and that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author emails as code — React Email, MJML, or an equivalent maintained framework the vendor documents first-party — and keep templates in version control
